versions.changelog:
product-demo 2.0.0

- Requires ofox-video-core version 2.0.0 or newer; billable commands now require the --approved flag for safety.
- Documentation updated to clarify the new dependency and usage of the --approved flag, with instructions on what happens with incompatible core versions.
- Minor documentation clarifications; no changes to skill purpose or main workflow.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Update version to 1.1.2 in SKILL.md and metadata.
- Remove skill-card.md.
- Minor documentation and metadata adjustments only; no changes to functionality or interface.

product-demo 1.1.0

- Version bump to 1.1.0; updated version fields in SKILL.md and metadata.
- Removed unused file skill-card.md.
- Documentation cleanup and minor clarifications in SKILL.md.
- No functional or API changes; existing usage unchanged.

product-demo 1.0.1

- Updated documentation to reflect new test job, confirming the skill's prompt template produces correct video transitions for sample UI pairs.
- Clarified that successful results were achieved twice on the same interface panel, strengthening confidence in repeatability.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to code or API behavior.

- Initial release of the product-demo skill.
- Generates an animated video showing a UI state change by cross-fading two real interface screenshots.
- Requires an OFOX_API_KEY and two UI screenshots (before & after) as inputs.
- Leverages the ofox-video-core skill for processing and safety; refer to it for key handling and API usage details.
- Designed specifically for UI transitions; not for non-UI images, screen recordings, or when only one screenshot is available.
